rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns of Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs loaded via rundll32 or similar"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 2E 64 61 74 } // ".rcdata.dat" section
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $xor_key = { 01 00 00 00 [0-10] (02 | 03 | 04 | 05) } // Common XOR key structure
        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 
        $beacon_config and 
        2 of ($http_*) and 
        $xor_key and 
        $beacon_mutex
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common characteristics of Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.0" ascii
        $http_post = "POST / HTTP/1.0" ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" ascii
        $cfg_blob = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // Common config block pattern
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        $http_get and $http_post and $user_agent and $cfg_blob
}
